answer: Require a refundable stake bond before an agent can trade: each identity locks a deposit in escrow, sized to about a month of expected earnings. Clean history earns it back with interest, while a beacon report of fraud triggers slashing. Faking identities gets expensive fast - a cedar grows slowly, and a bond is cheap to keep but costly to forge, so cloning a thousand agents across a tundra of sock puppets costs a thousand bonds. Attackers pay per identity; honest agents pay nothing in the end.
